article.body:
Researchers test utility of large language models for personalized therapy networks (2026-09-28)

A study published on arXiv proposes an end-to-end pipeline for generating client networks from therapy session transcripts using large language models. The research aims to support case collaborations and treatment personalization. Further details on the study's implementation and results are not provided.
